## d8b498586958

Audited source SHA-256:
`b5f72638b960c96622d4740f095d12eb103fb2a386c8ce6c84fbbb1489e48f4c`.
Declared rule hash: `10616a474432`. No target file was changed.

**A1 — Reproduced invalid canonical-shortcut declaration.** The combined audit
ran 27 task tests successfully, then failed the strict semantic gate because
`CANONICAL_SHORTCUTS['column_only_header']` matches only 2 of the 3 labeled
canonical pairs. On canonical test pair 0 it adds an extra row of 8s. A heuristic
that does not fit every canonical pair should be a lesson competitor, not a
canonical-fitting shortcut, unless its implementation is corrected. Exact
counterexample: `checks/audit/d8b498586958/canonical_shortcut_mismatch.json`.
Command and gate evidence:
`checks/audit/d8b498586958-combined-command.log` and
`checks/audit/d8b498586958-combined/checks/d8b498586958_audit_semantic_gate.log`.
The aggregate audit exited 1; the 27 passing tests do not erase the semantic
failure.

**A2 — Reproduced invalid scalar public controls.** A separate strict defect-lint
run exited 1 with 33 `strict-scalar` warnings plus one aggregate
`generator/authority structural mismatch` warning. The retained concrete
reproducer confirms that boolean seed values and negative sample indexes are
accepted, and that scheduling coerces integer-like values into undocumented
curriculum states. Evidence:
`checks/audit/d8b498586958/strict_scalar_counterexample.json` and
`checks/audit/d8b498586958/reproduce_strict_scalar.py`; detector log:
`checks/audit/d8b498586958-defect-lint/checks/d8b498586958_audit_defect_lint.log`.
The structural warning was not independently reduced here and is not promoted to
a separate confirmed defect.
